definitions.B_inventory: Original conservative wire(base inventory) ONCE, including all complete target metadata/keys. Keep existing source/scientific/control/numeric tiers independently.
definitions.I_local: Actual scientific identity emitted by original constructor for that local source/profile/IDs/sites. Empty capture lineage in capture; one bounded seven-field capture ref in shard. Include complete A1/source/code/model identity fields, not just hashes.
definitions.M_children: Native COMPLETE child-path/hash/byte descriptor envelope for THIS artifact, plus numeric array manifest descriptors if not already priced; actual byte path and integer limits.
definitions.E_execution: Entire actual execution header: runtime/source, local dummy IDs/controls, root-file refs, guards/reservation/allocation, measured startup fields <=STARTUP_REFERENCE_BYTES, and fit byte reference where emitted. Never assume4096 is enough without schema evidence.
definitions.K_expected: All actual shard-local expected keys, emitted once in its manifest (may conservatively double count keys already in B_inventory).
definitions.B_aux: Each actually emitted positive cache, reuse attestation, process startup, job/pilot completion/receipt, fit aggregate/fit completion, selection/adapted validation/selection metadata and summary. Count each actual serialized reference duplicate; repeated arrays and global refs stay explicit.
definitions.D_fit: Existing conservative fit-array descriptor envelope; distinguish capture array descriptors already within capture payload from fit/selected descriptors.

formula.scratch_v2: max of complete actual artifact upper byte envelopes and existing largest capture/row/control/inventory/array publication bounds, plus that artifact actual marker/header envelope; native sibling temporary rename does not duplicate every retained output.

monotonicity: Sum per emitter and actual field counts. Unrelated captures must not inflate an unchanged local identity; aggregate list grows linearly and is priced at its actual emitter. If real reference fanout repeats elsewhere, count that fanout explicitly.
unresolved_before_any_lowered_bound: Complete upper shape/size of live guard reservation/allocation/current-mapping references and per-process/receipt headers; bind to current source/root contract, not arbitrary4096.
Account all adapted validation and fit/selected bundle byte-reference/array descriptor fanout and every auxiliary publication, including duplicated metadata already present in row/cache components.

Actual source-schema fixture bounds must fit each genuine writer/reader for all profiles/edge paths; no full target build required to establish local schema, but final genuine inventory/digest and capacity acceptance require separate reviewed CPU work.
regression_proposal: AST/native tiny-publisher fixtures cover local capture/shard/marker schemas, maximum local IDs/sites/arrays/path/integer sizes, actual JSON escaping and final LF. No model/forward.
